physics_preflight.scope: 1.2s physical smoke, not fifteen-second graduation. Raw normals at four sampled environments only.

physics_preflight_acceptance.explanation: Physics smoke and pretrained policy performance are separate. Preserve original failed combined report; no claim of skill graduation.

scut_contact_window.semantics: per-wheel peak over 3 samples >1N; not simultaneous continuous loading

baseline.metric_population: per-environment means after first 0.5 s, censored at FIRST termination; survival denominator includes all environments
baseline.effort_sampling: 10ms control-step snapshots, not substep peak audit; computed-minus-applied >0.1Nm counts clipping

contact_physical_metrics_semantics.force_and_low_load: captured every.5ms; longest both norm force<=1N; low force is not airborne
contact_physical_metrics_semantics.gap_and_slip: sampled each10ms control; input USD hull support excludes cooking/offset/compliance; lowest-vertex slip approximation, not contact manifold
contact_physical_metrics_semantics.group_values: means of per-environment summaries; individual arrays retained in per_environment, not worst cases
contact_physical_metrics_semantics.integration: mean force per5ms impulse bins is a reward adaptation; bin pass is not continuous contact or legacy graduation

contact_capture_metadata.semantics: instantaneous sensor force at 5 ms endpoints; not accumulated impulses or continuous contact
contact_capture_metadata.reward_source: mean vector force = summed physical impulse /5ms; >1N per-wheel history maximum
contact_capture_metadata.peak_source: diagnostic only; not reward or graduation
contact_capture_metadata.adaptation: MOD4 .5ms substeps to5ms impulse bins; not identical upstream implementation

baseline.graduation_gate_contact_source: legacy control-endpoint shadow; corrected 5ms stats do not automatically promote speed
baseline.height_credit_semantics: unweighted exp height * recent contact; weighted per control step = credit * 0.3 * 0.01
baseline.physical_contact_evidence: reports/contact_probe_7450_20260930/FINDINGS.md in source root; 2kHz unload/gap/slip retained there, not overwritten by window stats
